flow.character_guide: Charming stylized 2D webcomic cartoon character in the authentic aesthetic of TheOdd1sOut, OverSimplified, and Dovahhatty: smooth minimalist white cartoon bean head (#FFFFFF), expressive cartoon eyes (dark beads, angry slanted brows, or shocked trembling pupils), expressive cartoon mouth (smiling, yelling wide with teeth/tongue, or deadpan line), curly cartoon hair or historical accessories (laurel wreath, pirate bandana, toga, cloak). Cartoon bean body proportions with white cartoon limbs and period clothing. Cel-shaded with clean thick black ink outlines. Dynamic comedic expressions (smug smirk, passionate shouting, shocked anime despair with sweat drops). Absolutely NO black stick figures, NO stickman limbs, NO realistic human noses, NO photorealistic rendering.
flow.look: Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. High-end 2D storytime webcomic cartoon illustration with bold black ink contours and cel-shaded digital colors. Vibrant dynamic lighting with atmospheric depth. Comedic visual acting and theatrical historical poses. Absolutely NO stickman stick figures, NO realistic human noses, NO photorealistic modern elements, NO 3D CGI renders.

editorial.voice: Conversational, immersive, and vivid historical storytelling narrator. Speaks in the second-person 'you' or empathetic third-person. Contrasts the grand marble facade of ancient civilizations with the gritty, visceral reality of daily plebeian life (food, hygiene, rent, taboos, survival). Clear, relaxed, engaging pacing with dry, observant wit. Never academic jargon, never glorification.
rules: Ground every scene in sensory, visceral details: the taste of bitter puls porridge, the stench of insula stairwells, the cold marble of public baths, the creak of wooden carts on basalt pavers.
Explain historical mechanisms: how grain subsidies (annona) worked, how insula landlords extorted tenants, how legionary rations were prepared, how aqueduct water was taxed.

Maintain character visual consistency: stylized 2D cartoon bean-head characters in the authentic aesthetic of TheOdd1sOut, OverSimplified, and Dovahhatty with expressive cartoon facial features, wearing historically accurate tunics, togas, and accessories against rich scenic backdrops. Absolutely NO stick figures, NO stickman limbs.
Vary pacing with the 7-act structure: start with an immersive dawn wake-up hook, explore morning routines, public spaces, noon struggles, social contrasts, evening survival, and final reflections.
Never use generic AI cliches or empty superlatives.

title_formulas: Why Was [Everyday Taboo / Commodity] the Most Valuable Thing in Ancient Rome?
Why Did Ancient Romans [Bizarre Daily Habit / Hygiene] on Street Corners?
The Disgusting [Mechanism / Tax] That Saved the Roman Empire
What Did Ancient Romans Actually Do With All That [Object / Resource]?

composition_rules: Foreground Left (1/3 of frame): Large close-up bust of signature 2D cartoon bean-head character (#FFFFFF) with exaggerated comical emotion (disgust, shock, shivering, smug grin, shouting)
Background Right: Core narrative premise visually exaggerated (spilling amphora, bubbling wash vat, emperor with coin)
Upper Third: Clean negative space for bold 2-3 word yellow text hook
STRICT: Absolutely NO text, words, letters, logos, banners in the image generation prompt
